type PlainArray<U extends U[]> = U;
type PlainTuple<U extends [U]> = U;
type ObjectTemplate<U extends {name: `${U & string}`}> = U;
type ObjectMapping<U extends {name: Uppercase<U & string>}> = U;
type FunctionMapping<U extends () => Uppercase<U & string>> = U;
type ArrayBranded<U extends Array<U & {tag: 1}>> = U;
type ArrayUnion<U extends Array<U | string>> = U;
type ArrayNoInfer<U extends Array<NoInfer<U> & string>> = U;
type GenericPattern<T extends string, U extends [U & `key-${T}`]> = U;
type Narrow<T> = T & string;
type AliasedAny<T> = Narrow<T> | any;
type ErasedAlias<U extends AliasedAny<U>> = U;
type SkippedBranch<U extends (true extends false ? Array<U & string> : {})> = U;
type InferredObject<T> = T extends [infer U extends {name: `${U & string}`}, infer U] ? U : never;

const skipped: SkippedBranch<{}> = {};
const erased: ErasedAlias<string> = 'done';
console.log(erased, skipped);
